individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial heatmap-style plot of cell deconvolution fractions overlaid on tissue; heatmaps are exempt from needing individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Heatmap-style spatial plot has no error bars to define.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots already convey the data distribution (and individual points are additionally overlaid here), so this is exempt and passes regardless.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: The box plots represent the distribution of values for each group, extending from the 25th percentile to the 75th percentile; T11b-high LUSC: Classical monocyte (minima=0.00035, median=0.32265, maxima=1, Q1 = 0.16193, Q3 = 0.52806)...
error-bars-defined.explanation: Caption fully defines the box plot elements (minima, median, maxima, Q1, Q3) for every group shown.

individual-data-points.explanation: GSEA enrichment score line plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the GSEA enrichment plots; NES/FDR/p values are reported as text instead.

individual-data-points.explanation: Bar chart of log2 fold change for top M2/TAM genes shows only single bars with p-values, no individual data points overlaid.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown on the bars; only p-values are annotated above each bar.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel E is a set of micrographs, not a plot, so error bars do not apply.
